title: Nebula Protocol
tagline: Nebula is your digital universe. Every user is an Element, each with its unique identity Atoms. Manage them securely in our Atom Registry. We verify their authenticity, giving you control to shape your online persona. Nebula, where you're at the center of your digital world.
description:
Imagine Nebula as a cosmic hub where every user is a unique Element. These Elements are like personalized avatars, and each can gather multiple identities known as Atoms. Think of Atoms as the facets of your online self, such as your ENS domain, NFT collection, and social media profiles.

To make this possible, we've crafted an Atom Registry, a place where you can securely register and manage your Atoms. This registry keeps everything organized and safe. When you add an Atom, we ensure it's really yours, so you can trust that your online identity is accurate and reliable.

Our goal is to make the process easy, so you have full control over which Atoms you associate with your Element. Nebula is about giving you the power to manage your digital identity, whether you're connecting with others or interacting within the Nebula ecosystem.

So, think of Nebula as your personalized cosmic identity center, where you are the star, and Atoms are the building blocks of your online presence.
how_its_made: This project is built using Solidity. We are planning to use connext protocol to share the identity across different L2's and/or sidechains. There are multiple smart contracts which handle different functions of protocol such as a Registry which takes care of registering and working with multiple atoms.
